# orders

Takes orders from the shop and hands each one to billing.

setup:
	python3 -m venv .venv
	.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

test:
	.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q

run:
	.venv/bin/python -m orders --port 8040

# ledger

Keeps the balance of every customer account for billing.
